requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-4452-5361--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Rukarumel, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Auton Soldier. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Rukarumel, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

1003-5006-5231-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
1003-5006-5231-8170.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {R}
Repeat.

4929-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Cryptic Trilobite is in your graveyard.
4929-5006-8170.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Cryptic Trilobite. It enters as dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat.

1385-1981-2415-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1436-5261-5475.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-5261-5475.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

5226-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
5226-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

647-1395-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4247-6351-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1303-3249-5147-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of Shambling Ghast.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing both Shambling Ghasts.
When the Shambling Ghasts die, they triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2713-4893-7426-7648.description:
Activate Assassin Den by paying {U} due to Training Grounds and Zirda, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

240-5470-6797-6965.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1353-3327-4535-4613-5073.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1353-3327-4535-4613-5073.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

985-4050-5043-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

3204-4068-4364-6188.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You control at least one Mountain.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
3204-4068-4364-6188.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

465-1753-3742-4251-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-1753-3742-4251-4452.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2793-3017-3743-4094-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3017-3743-4094-5089.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2793-3017-3743-4094-5089.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Activate Kaya's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, giving creatures you control deathtouch until end of turn and putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature token you control.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1339-4268-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4268-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2921-4321-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
2921-4321-5777.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

628-5231-5523.notablePrerequisites: Defiant Greatmaw does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-5231-5523.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw, adding {R}.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
Defiant Greatmaw's second ability triggers, removing a -1/-1 counter from another creature you control.
Repeat.

1365-1537-2034-4751.notablePrerequisites: Zealous Conscripts and Verduous Gearhulk do not have a -1/-1 counter on them.
1365-1537-2034-4751.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Verdurous Gearhulk and Zealous Conscripts persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, adding {C}{C}.
When Zealous Conscripts dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Verdurous Gearhulk, adding {C}{C}.
When Verdurous Gearhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Zealous Conscripts, and two +1/+1 counters on any other creature(s) you control.
Repeat.

2350-4311-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

49-1216-1799-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Sengir Autocrat, adding {R}.
When Sengir Autocrat leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, exiling all Serf tokens.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sengir Autocrat enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating three 0/1 Serf creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing the Serfs, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3338-3682-3772-4331.notablePrerequisites: Omen Hawker does not have summoning sickness.
3338-3682-3772-4331.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Omen Hawker.
Activate Omen Hawker by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and/or planeswalkers you control.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Mox Amber from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other creature using Mirran Spy.

1325-2034-2074-4417.notablePrerequisites: Vorapede does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1325-2034-2074-4417.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Vorapede, adding {C}{C}.
Vorapede dies, triggering itself and Kheru Bloodsucker.
Resolve the Vorapede trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}, two life and removing the +1/+1 counter from Vorapede, giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

798-1082-4050.description:
Cast Faerie Impostor by paying {U}.
Faerie Impostor and Dual Nature's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Dual Nature ability, creating a token copy of Faerie Impostor.
The Faerie Impostor token triggers, returning the nontoken Faerie Impostor from the battlefield to your hand.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers.
In response, sacrifice the token Faerie Impostor to Phyrexian Altar for {U}.
Resolve the Dual Nature ability, exiling zero creatures.
Resolve the Faerie Impostor ability, returning a creature you control from the battlefield to your hand if desired.
Repeat.

174-1636-2034-5168.notablePrerequisites:
You control a white and black permanent.
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
174-1636-2034-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Worldheart Phoenix enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

539-3995-5227.notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to Horseshoe Crab.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
Horseshoe Crab does not have summoning sickness.
539-3995-5227.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping itself.
Repeat.
